discovery.clonePolicy: Official clones are read-only onboarding snapshots and never replace the local monorepo copies.

promotionPolicy.featureToDevelop: feat/*, fix/* or chore/* -> PR -> develop
promotionPolicy.developToQa: approved commit -> cherry-pick -x -> qa/<work-item> -> PR -> qa
promotionPolicy.qaToMain: validated QA commit -> cherry-pick -x -> release/<version> -> PR -> main

notes: Catalog API and Sales API already contain independent implementations; they are not first-extraction scaffolds.
Gateway, Front and Catalog Portal have code in unmerged feature branches but their develop branches are incomplete.
See repository-validation.md for evidence, validation limits and the next P0.
